message: fix(merchant): require explicit selection after a sold stack disappears
purpose: Prevent a rapid second click from selling another item after the selected stack disappears. Initial page opening may select its first item, but removal or later arrival of items must not select another destructive action. Preserve all existing assertions and add native pointer coverage with a second unsold item still present. No change to prices, quantities, authority or inventory limits.
